lighting_notes: Dark living room, matching sc04's apartment but now entirely unlit/hostile — minimal practical light, heavy shadow. This is the darkest scene in the episode tonally and visually.
action: Ananya sits huddled on the floor, small suitcase beside her. Rohit enters, slams the door, face twisted in fury. The confrontation escalates until Rohit grabs a heavy wooden decorative club from a nearby stand and swings it down with brutal force at Ananya.

dialogue.line: Your father called me. He disowned you completely! Not a single cent of their wealth is coming to you!
Rohit... I know about Priya. I know you never loved me.
Loved you? You think I spent a single second caring about you? You were my ticket out of poverty! And now? You're useless to me. No inheritance... and you can't even bear an heir!
You monster... I'm leaving. Everyone will know what you did—
No one is going to know anything.

shot_list.description: Ananya huddled on the floor, suitcase beside her, establishing her isolation and vulnerability
Rohit entering, the escalating dialogue exchange
Ananya's face on 'Rohit, no—!' — the scene ends on her, not on graphic violence

continuity_notes: Sensitive content — the climax of the story. Recommend handling the final blow off-screen or via a hard cut/fade rather than depicting impact directly (matches the script's own restraint — it ends on Ananya's horrified reaction line, then 'FADE TO BLACK', not on the strike itself). Production note: this is the episode's most consequential scene for tone — coordinate pacing/music/sound design choices with the overall project's intent before animating.
